items.item: No Update Records (DML) or Get Records inside a Loop; builds a collection and updates it once, or uses Update Records with related-record criteria
items.evidence: "There is no Loop and no Get Records." Update Records with filter `AccountId` Equals `{!$Record.Id}`

items.item: Entry condition only when an address field changes
items.evidence: OR(ISCHANGED({!$Record.BillingStreet}), ISCHANGED(...BillingCity) ...) "fires only when an address field actually changes"
"**Fault connector** goes to element 3." (Send Email admin on failure)

items.item: Mentions bulk behaviour (200 Accounts saved at once, many Contacts per Account)
items.evidence: "saves up to **200 Accounts per transaction**... 200 Accounts with 60 Contacts each is 12,000 Contact rows, which **fails**"
